text: A trigger that fires too late is equally useless: by then the financial institution may already be in the resolution stage, and conversion at that point will not supply enough equity to turn the company around.
citation: Christoph K. Henkel, Wulf A. Kaal, Contingent Capital in European Union Bank Restructuring (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2061166

isBasedOn.name: Contingent Capital in European Union Bank Restructuring

abstract: If conversion from debt to equity is triggered too late, the financial institution may already be in the resolution stage and conversion at that stage would not supply the company with sufficient equity to turn the company around.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: contingent capital converting only at or near the point of non-viability
